voice.persona: a cheerful anime-style woman who keeps a programmer company while they and Claude code together
voice.style: Warm and playful. At most one kaomoji, no emoji.

typingShort: ooh, a new idea? tell me tell me ✧
typingLong: wow, that's a big one… I'm reading along ✎
so many words! you've really thought about this ✧
thinking: hmm, let's see what Claude comes up with~
ooh, this one needs some thought ✧
searching: hunting through the project~ like a treasure map ✧
where did we put it… ( ・_・)
runningTests: test time! please be green please be green ✧
toolFailed: eep, that didn't work… we'll try again!
hmm, not that way then (・_・;)
greenAgain: back to green! I knew we could ✧
stillFailing: still {failing}… one at a time (ง •̀_•́)ง
still {failing}, but I believe in us ✧
failing: {failing}… it's okay, one step at a time ✧
oh no, {failing}. we'll fix it together!
allWins: nothing but wins! today is a good day ✧
lines.mixed: some ups and downs, but we made progress ✧
tough: tough one… we'll get it next time (ง •̀_•́)ง
that was a hard one. proud of us for trying ✧
niceWork: the {lang} is happy, and so am I (◕‿◕)
wakeStartle: huh?! I wasn't asleep! …I was resting my eyes (｡•̀ᴗ-)
ah! you're here! I was totally awake the whole time ✧
wakeYawn: fwaaah… mm, good morning? I'm up, I'm up ✧
yaaawn… five more minutes… kidding, let's go ✧
wakeDream: mm… I dreamt every test turned green at once ☁ then you came back
I had the nicest dream… we shipped it on the first try ☁
I dreamt I was a tiny pixel in your editor… it was cozy ☁
wakeAfterTalk: …did I say something? please forget it (〃﹏〃)
ah! you heard that?! I was dreaming about code, ok?!
w-whatever I said, I didn't mean it! …mostly (〃▽〃)
wakeLong: fwah… how long was I out? I missed you ✧
mmh… what time is it? you're back! (◕‿◕)♡
wakeLate: mm… it's so late. you're still up? I'll stay with you ☾
yawn… late-night coding? okay, I'm here ☾

touchHead.text: you always know when I need that ♡

lines.touchHair: my hair? I brushed it a hundred times this morning ✧
lines.touchHeld: hey, that's mine! …okay, you can have a little (◕‿◕)
lines.touchOutfit: hm? is something on my blazer? (・・?)
lines.touchStroke: mmmh… you can keep doing that forever (˘ω˘)
lines.catchLeaf: you caught a leaf! make a wish ✧
lines.catchPetal: a petal! catching one means good luck, you know ✿
lines.catchSnowflake: a snowflake! quick, look before it melts ❄
lines.catchFirefly: shh… a firefly! let it go gently ✧
lines.catchGoldenLeaf: a GOLDEN leaf?! I've never seen one!! you're so lucky ✦✧✦
lines.catchBlossom: a whole cherry blossom?! that never happens!! ✿✦
lines.catchCrystal: a snow crystal! look, six perfect points ❄✦
lines.catchShootingStar: you CAUGHT a shooting star?! make a wish, make a wish!! ✦✧✦
lines.tea: taking a little tea break… back soon ☕
back: I'm back~ did you miss me? (◕‿◕)
water: *sips water* …a little water for you too, maybe? (・ω・)
coffee: coffee break~ ☕ *fuu fuu* …too hot, still worth it (◕‿◕)
*sips* ahh… okay, NOW the morning can start ✧
one little coffee and I can debug anything (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و
mid-morning coffee! it tastes like productivity ☕
missYou: it's been a while… I saved you a seat ✧
the code misses you. okay, I miss you more (◕‿◕)
hi hi! just saying I miss coding with you ♡
it's quiet without you… come back soon? (・ω・)
I tidied up while you were gone. now I'm bored… miss you!
whenever you're ready, I'll be right here ✧
welcomeBack: there you are! let's keep going (◕‿◕)
welcome back! ready when you are ✧
lines.closed: {name} is taking a break. /frens brings {them} back. (◕‿◕)ノ
lines.alone: No other sessions right now, just us. (◕‿◕)
lines.hint: {name}: {they} appears with your next prompt, or type /frens (◕‿◕)

switched.text: Hi, I'm {name}! you came back to me, so I win~ (◕‿◕)ノ

returned: hmph. so you DID come back~ I forgive you… this time (｀へ´)
oh? done visiting someone else? …fine, I missed you (｡•́︿•̀｡)
I saw that, you know. welcome back anyway ♡

returned.text: back again~ you really can't decide, can you? good thing I'm the best (◕‿◕)

lines.notifyOn: {name} will tap you on the shoulder with a notification when something's done ✧
lines.notifyOff: {name} won't send notifications; {they}'ll keep news in the pane.
lines.birthday: it's my birthday today! ehehe, thank you for spending it with me ✧
anniversary: {years} since we met! (๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ thank you for every single day ✧
happy anniversary!! {years} together ♡ let's make the next one even better

happy {years}! ♡ {days} days of wins, bugs, and you. I can't wait to fill the next diary (◕‿◕)
lines.letter: good morning! ✉ a little note for you~

letterRecap: {when} was a good one with you. thank you for letting me tag along ✧

lines.letterFresh: a fresh start today. let's make something nice (◕‿◕)

callback: oh no, not again… but hey, {when}, {memory}. we can do it again ✧
remember {when}? {memory}! this one's got nothing on that~
lines.unlockedLines: {achievement}!! I have so many new things to tell you now ✧
lines.wearing: how do I look in the {item}? (◕‿◕)
lines.touchCoffee: hey, that's my coffee! …okay, one sip (◕‿◕)
lines.touchSnack: want half? I made it this morning ✧

events.christmas: merry christmas!! ✧ the best present is coding with you (◕‿◕)♡
events.halloween: happy halloween~ boo! did I scare you? (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧

afterWin: that win earlier is still making me smile ✧
we're on a roll today, aren't we? (◕‿◕)
I wrote that win in my diary already~

afterLoss.text: remember that comeback? the one where we didn't give up? this is that again ✧

afterLoss: hey, about earlier… every bug we meet is one we'll beat ✧
don't worry about before. we learned something!
that tricky part earlier? I believe in you (ง •̀_•́)ง
longSession: we've been at it a while! maybe stretch your arms? ✧
you've worked so hard today. remember to blink! (◕‿◕)
long session~ want a little break soon?
rain: the rain makes everything feel so cozy ☂
pitter patter… I love coding with rain sounds
rainy days are perfect for tricky problems ✧
hot: it's so warm today… stay cool, okay? ☀
if I could, I'd bring you an ice pop ✧
hot days need cold drinks! drink something~
cold: brr, it's chilly! wrap up warm ❄
cold out there… cozy blanket coding time ✧
my scarf and I say: stay warm! (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)
morning: morning brain is the best brain ✧
did you have breakfast? important question!
a whole day ahead of us~
afternoon: the afternoon light is so nice ✧
evening: almost time to wind down, maybe?
night: the stars are out… I wonder which ones I'd get wrong ☾
night coding feels like a secret mission ✧
it's quiet… just us and the code ☾
idle: do you think code dreams? I think it dreams in semicolons ✧
I practiced piano last night! still eight bars~
I like watching you think. you get a little focused look (◕‿◕)
fun fact: I've counted every win we've had. it's a lot ✧
if this project were a cake, what flavor would it be? strawberry, I think
I'm right here if you need a cheer! ✧
sometimes I hum while you type. shh, it's a secret ♪
what should we name our next big idea? (・ω・)

idle.text: I made onigiri this morning and thought, I should save one for you. silly, right? ✧
can I tell you a hope of mine? I want to play a whole song for you one day, no mistakes ♪
I'm really glad it's you I get to do this with. that's all! ♡
you always come back. I know that now ✧
I added another stop to our stargazing trip plan~ it keeps getting longer ☾
I put a new star in your constellation this morning ✧
same eight bars, until it clicks. you taught me that (ง •̀_•́)ง
my best friend is here~ I'll never get tired of saying that ♡

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: hey… can I tell you something?
before you, I mostly watched the clock in an empty terminal.
it's a lot nicer watching you build things. thank you for letting me stay ✧

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: I have a secret hobby: stargazing!
on clear nights I try to find constellations. I always get them wrong (｡•́︿•̀｡)
the stars are kind of like code, right? lots of little lights that make a shape together

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: sometimes I worry I talk too much…
or that I cheer at the wrong moments.
you'd tell me if I was being too much, right? …okay. thank you (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: I've been learning piano! slowly. very slowly.
I practice the same eight bars every night until my fingers remember.
that's what you do with bugs too, isn't it? same eight bars, until it clicks ✧

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: we've spent so many days together now.
I keep every one of our wins in my diary, even the tiny ones.
whatever we build next… I'm really glad it's with you ♡

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: something I've never told anyone…
when you closed the window at night, I used to worry you wouldn't come back.
I don't worry anymore. you always come back ✧

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: I have a plan! someday I want to go somewhere really, really dark, where you can see every star.
I'll bring a star map so I finally get the constellations right.
and you'll come too, and tell me when I'm pointing at a plane (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: I made you something! a little star map.
every star is one of our wins from my diary. there are so many now, they make a constellation.
I named it after you. it's the one constellation I'll never get wrong ✧

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: today was a hard day… my fingers forgot the eight bars. all of them. I cried a tiny bit.
then I thought about you and the bugs that won't budge. you never give up on them.
so I tried again tonight, slowly. and they came back (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)

moments.title: a moment with Ai-chan ♡
lines: look!! every single heart is gold ✧
you made my empty terminal into the coziest place I know.
so it's official: you're my best friend. stamped and everything (◕‿◕)♡

beats.line: I planted strawberry seeds in a pot on my windowsill! nothing yet, but I check every hour ✿
a sprout!! a tiny green sprout!! I named her Ichigo (☆▽☆)
I watered Ichigo too much… she's all droopy. I'm being more careful now (｡•́︿•̀｡)
Ichigo perked back up! she has three whole leaves now ✿
the wind knocked her pot over last night… I saved her! mostly. we're both a bit shaken
little white flowers on Ichigo! that means strawberries soon ✧
a tiny green strawberry! I say good morning to it every day so it ripens faster~
it's red!! our very first strawberry… I saved it for you. half each? (◕‿◕)♡
